about.label: ABOUT US
about.title: Stanford English Academy

context.title: The institution and its context
context.p1: Stanford English Academy (S.E.A.) was created as an option to complement, update, and supplement knowledge and training in academic and vocational areas, generating opportunities for economic and social development in the municipality of Los Patios, in the department of Norte de Santander, by promoting academic and vocational training through linguistic and communicative competencies for young people and adults who join our educational organization.
context.p2: This educational purpose makes Stanford English Academy (S.E.A.) a leading organization in fostering high-quality educational processes that are relevant and aligned with the development visions set out in Colombia's National Development Plan 2024–2027 «Norte territorio de paz» and the Municipal Development Plan 2024–2027 «Building a safe and caring city!»
context.p3: Through fieldwork carried out by members of Stanford English Academy (S.E.A.), we have found that many factors lie behind the challenges affecting the local community—economic, social, political, cultural, and environmental. This community needs to be mobilized socially by improving conditions that support academic, vocational, civic, and human development so that its members can directly contribute to collective well-being.
context.p4: From this institutional vision, Stanford English Academy (S.E.A.) emerges as a new pedagogical organization committed to understanding education as a dynamic learning process that optimizes human capacities, through which individuals not only acquire cultural goods and values but also integrate critically and creatively into everyday social life.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: By 2029, Stanford English Academy (S.E.A.) will be a benchmark in the municipality of Los Patios and the department of Norte de Santander, recognized for offering education of the highest quality as an innovative language-teaching experience.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: To provide an excellent, highly competitive, innovative, and quality teaching service that enables our students to develop communicative skills in languages, serving the entire educational community of Los Patios and Norte de Santander and helping them expand their job opportunities and personal growth.

about.legal: Stanford School Academy is a private institution for Education for Work and Human Development. It is governed by Law 1064 of 2006 and Decree 1075 of 2015, with an operating license from the Departmental Secretariat of Education.

institution.title: About our institution
institution.content: We are a language training academy serving basic, secondary, technical, and higher education in group and individual settings, providing responsible, high-quality service.

whatIsStanford.title: What is Stanford?
whatIsStanford.p1: We are an academy with more than 14 years of experience in language teaching. We are passionate about serving and helping our entire educational community achieve their dreams by facilitating second-language learning.
whatIsStanford.p2: We are fully committed to making a positive impact on every child, young person, and adult by offering better job opportunities and quality of life.

q1.question: How do I enroll in a course?
q1.answer: Create an account with your email, sign in, and choose a course on our platform. An admin can assign you specific courses.

q2.question: Can I study at my own pace?
q2.answer: Yes. All content stays available on mobile and desktop so you can progress whenever you want.

q3.question: How do exams work?
q3.answer: You must view all material and pass the final evaluation. Open questions are reviewed by an administrator.

q4.question: How many exam attempts do I get?
q4.answer: Each course defines the maximum attempts and time limit; your administrator configures them.
